channel.title: Press Release For Business — Health
channel.description: Announcements categorized as health. All items are paid announcements published on behalf of the named organization and are not independently verified.

item.title: Elevation Health Pairs Registered-Dietitian Support With Physician-Prescribed GLP-1 Care as Research Highlights an Industry-Wide Support Gap
item.description: Elevation Health structures its telehealth GLP-1 program around registered-dietitian support alongside physician prescribing, in response to published 2026 research identifying high discontinuation rates and limited nutritional oversight across the telehealth weight-management sector.

item.title: Elevation Health Publishes a Plain Description of Its Consultation Process
item.description: Elevation Health has published a step-by-step description of its telehealth consultation process, including the assessment stage at which a clinician may determine that an applicant is not a candidate.
